notes: Proved: A202146 g.f. = sum q^n (q;q)_n/(q;q^2)_{n+1} is congruent mod 2 to sum (-q)^n (-q;q)_n/(q;q^2)_{n+1} = sum_m (-1)^m q^{3m(m+1)} (identity (*)), via a Bailey pair and Bailey's lemma (a=q, rho1=q, rho2=-1). Lean (checked, imports OpenProblemsLib.QSeries): A202146_entry_parity (A202146(k) from the entry's g.f. is odd iff k = 3m(m+1)); route E_closed, bailey_pair, star (identity (*): TL_succ, sum_TL, In_pos, In_zero, pair_zero, pair_succ, library qGaussSum_mul), mod2_reduction, A202146_entry_eq. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none. Only the reading of the entry's g.f. formula as the Lean definition entryTerm is not machine-checked. Numerics: (*) and parity to degree 1500, A202146 b-file (1501 terms) by certificate/check.py.
